openFindings.title: Model-server detection misses a server whose script path contains a space
Exact-path allowlist rows exempt the whole file, so new lane text in an allowlisted live file passes repo mode
Phases 001 and 006 tick 23 checklist rows that cite no evidence, including four test-coverage claims
Apply deletes whatever regular file HF_EMBED_SERVER_URL names, with no check that it is a socket
Parent goal still reads unstarted: all five completion criteria unchecked and phases 001 to 008 logged as Pending
Phase 005 docs still say Blocked and not committed, though its commit exists and the removed packages are gone from node_modules
The lane-residue gate is documented as running on every push, but the push trigger only covers main and skilled/**
32 of 47 allowlist reasons cite line numbers that the check never verifies, so the reasons drift without failing anything
Lane-residue catalog page and workflow header say every push is gated; push triggers only main and skilled/**
M7 drops lane keys on lines the dotenv parser rejects and still reports the check absent

playbook flags, ordering and askFirst semantics match YAML and tool

branch diff over the four runtime agent folders is empty; no mirror changed
